BiblicalUsage: En-Chaddah is a place in Palestine. The name appears in Joshua (Joshua 19:21). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Chaddah matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Chaddah is one of them.
